svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from 10 mm S355 plate, blank 500 x 200; one piece, no forging

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spike: tip on the centre line, 440 from the socket end of the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shank 36 wide; the 56 wide end (62 long) goes into the socket slots

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm 48 wide hangs 117 below the shank, raked back 17 deg; barb at its foot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rope tab under the shank, 25 to 85 from the socket end, round end R30

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shackle hole 13, centred 55 from the socket end and 55 below the axis

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside corners at the arm and tab: drill 16 and file to R8; no sharp notch

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut by plasma or chain drill and grinder; dress all edges, break corners 1

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Throat between tab and arm: 150 wide at the shank, 128 at 100 below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: plate stands 2.6 proud of the tube top and bottom for the welds

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay on the full-size print; every edge within 1 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stamp WLL 3 kN and the serial number on the shank before painting
